label: Brent Crude
value: $104.61/bbl Fri close (-2.8% d/d), markets shut over the weekend's escalation
delta: Settled Friday down from Thursday's ~$107.63 close but still up roughly 9% on the week; markets were closed Sep 12-13 as Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline stayed shut, an Iranian vessel was struck off Qeshm Island (1 killed), and Houthis completed their takeover of Bab el-Mandeb -- all setting up a volatile Monday open around the same-day Oman summit

label: Saudi East-West Pipeline
value: Shut since Sep 11 (~4-5M bpd, 4-5% of global supply)
delta: Iraq-origin drone strikes forced a precautionary shutdown of Saudi Arabia's main Hormuz-bypass pipeline; industry sources say Yanbu's Red Sea export stocks cover only 5-7 days before exports must be curtailed

label: Bab el-Mandeb Daily Transits
delta: New second chokepoint risk: Houthi capture of Yemen's Mokha port and advance toward the strait cut Red Sea vessel crossings from 30 (Wed) to 12 (Thu), narrowing the Suez/Red Sea bypass route shippers have used to avoid the closed Strait of Hormuz

label: US Diesel Price
delta: Crossed $6/gallon for the first time as the Sep 9-10 shipping-attack wave and the new Red Sea front pushed Brent toward its $108 crisis peak

label: FAO Food Price Index
source: FAO (Aug 2026, released Sep 4 -- highest since late 2022)
delta: Up 1.9% from July's revised level and 2.5% y/y; broad-based across all five commodity groups -- sugar +11.9% m/m, cereals +2.2% m/m (highest since May 2024), dairy +2.3% m/m

label: Hormuz Daily Tanker Transits
source: Kpler via Al Jazeera / US Energy Secretary Chris Wright via PBS-Reuters (Sep 3-9, 2026)
contestNote: Kpler counted single-digit-to-low-teens vessels crossing per day in early September, well below its own 10-day average of ~13/day; on Sep 7 Energy Secretary Chris Wright said roughly 9 million barrels/day (about two-thirds of pre-war flow) were moving under the US-led escort regime -- a gap Al Jazeera attributes to the US including naval-escort and support vessels excluded from commercial tracking data
deltaNote: Traffic remains far below pre-war levels; the Sep 8-9 tanker destructions, IRGC's unconfirmed claim of enforcing Iran's new 'restricted zone,' and the Houthi strike on Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery add fresh uncertainty

label: 2026 Global Growth Forecast
